title: Among users aged between 13 and 30 who own posts with at least 50 views, fi
question: Among users aged between 13 and 30 who own posts with at least 50 views, find the user whose posts have received the highest total number of comments. Return their display name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
INNER JOIN comments AS T3 ON T2."XCL_026" = T3."XCL_006"
WHERE T1."XCL_064" BETWEEN 13 AND 30
  AND T2."XCL_030" >= 50
GROUP BY T1."XCL_052", T1."XCL_055"
ORDER BY COUNT(T3."XCL_005") DESC
LIMIT 1;
